attestation.title: Hardware Attestation
attestation.description: Status is read from the enclave vTPM OIDC claims through the server-side blind proxy and cross-checked against the deployed VerifiableRAG contract on Coston2.
attestation.judgesNotice: Judges: Click here for deployment details
attestation.noticeBody: The hardware attestation service requires Google Cloud Confidential Space with Intel TDX hardware, which costs approximately $300/month (~500,000 NGN). This is currently offline but the full architecture is proven in the codebase. The system falls back to honest 503 responses rather than fabricating attestation data.
